name: Prime Visa

apr.notes: Purchase APR 18.74% to 27.49% variable based on creditworthiness. Cash Advance APR 28.49% variable. Penalty APR up to 29.99%. Variable APRs based on 6.75% Prime Rate. Maximum APR 29.99%.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees. You will pay no foreign transaction fees when you use your card for purchases made outside the United States.

rewards.currency_label: % back rewards (tracked as points; each $1 in % back rewards = 100 points)

base_rate.description: 1% back on all other purchases anywhere Visa is accepted.

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem points as soon as the next day with daily rewards at Amazon.com. No minimum rewards balance to redeem. Can also redeem for cash back, gift cards, and travel at Chase.com. Every 100 points = $1.00 when redeemed at Amazon.com or Chase.com.

signup_bonus.description: $150 Amazon Gift Card instantly loaded into your Amazon account's Gift Card Balance on approval of your credit card application. Prime members only.

benefits.title: Prime Card Bonus
benefits.description: Eligible Prime cardmembers earn 10% back or more on a rotating selection of items and categories on Amazon.com. Limited-time offers.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends the time period of the manufacturer's U.S. warranty by an additional year, on eligible warranties of three years or less, up to four years from the date of purchase.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers your eligible new purchases for 120 days from the date of purchase against damage or theft up to $500 per item.

benefits.title: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimburses you up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases like toiletries and clothing when baggage is delayed over 6 hours.

benefits.title: Zero Liability Protection
benefits.description: Zero Liability means you won't be held responsible for unauthorized charges made with your card or account information.

benefits.title: Roadside Assistance
benefits.description: If you have a roadside emergency, call the service provider to dispatch the help you need. Roadside service fees will be billed to your card at time of dispatch.

benefits.title: Travel Accident Insurance
benefits.description: When you pay for your air, bus, train or cruise transportation with your card, you are eligible to receive up to $500,000 in accidental death or dismemberment coverage.

benefits.title: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Provides reimbursement up to $3,000 per covered traveler for the cost to repair or replace checked or carry-on baggage that is lost, damaged or stolen during a covered trip.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Coverage
benefits.description: Decline the rental company's collision insurance and charge the entire rental cost to your card. Coverage provides reimbursement for theft and collision damage for most rental vehicles.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: You will pay no foreign transaction fees when you use your card for purchases made outside the United States.
